title: Kagamine Rin — Let's Enjoy The School Festival♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wow!
That all really happened during the School Festival at Kohane's school?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! And she ended up chasing An all around the school because she couldn't get that wolf's head off!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, don't laugh!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I heard from Kohane and the others earlier, but it really must've been quite an ordeal.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... She ran into a class that was running a cafe, which scared all the customers...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And after that, she ended up being a part of a play by accident?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I was doing my best to help guide Kohane, but we were having so much trouble catching up to An...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't she so athletic that the other sports clubs are always asking her for help?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, if a girl like that decided to run at full speed, catching her's never going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But Kohane's friends and classmates all helped you find her, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! This other girl from Kohane's class borrowed some tools to get the wolf's head off.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, An finally realized that it was all just a big mistake! After that, we got to actually enjoy the festival!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see, so all's well that ends well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No fair.
I wish I could've gone...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry, but it serves you right for leaving me behind to go train.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's settle down. It's all in the past now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know. Why don't I make some of the food and drinks that appeared in Rin's story? What would you all like?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You mean it?! Then, yakisoba!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to try those pot sticker cookies!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, the sushi sweets also caught my interest.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay... Pot sticker cookies and sushi chocolates, right? Wish me luck. Those may prove challenging...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... If anything, I'm more interested in how they're put together.

rows.Speaker: Rin & MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, coming up with your own shop or attraction has to be a lot of fun, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'm curious as to how that process works.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank goodness. That's what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Why do you all look so surprised? Did I say something strange just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha... Don't mind us...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, Miku, what would you like to have done the most during a School Festival?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to know as well!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I haven't really put much thought into it, but putting a maze together sounds fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A maze?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Think about it. Don't most of us enjoy wandering around the back alleys of this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I thought it'd be fun to have others experience that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. That does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As for me, I'd like to run an ice cream stall!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Good for you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww, you could show a little more interest! Anyway, Luka, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me? Well... I'd probably like to do a takoyaki stall.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And it won't have octopus in them, but a whole bunch of stuff! So what you get inside will be all up to chance♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds fun...! But I'd have to work up the courage to eat them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No octopus? Can you even call them “takoyaki” at that point...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about you, MEIKO? My guess is a cafe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's what I'm used to, and it'd probably go pretty well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it could be fun to try something completely new for a change.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
How about you, Rin, Len?
What would you two do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... It's gotta be that, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, given the choice, it's really gotta be that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what would “that” be?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That would be...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: A cotton candy stall!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew you'd say the same thing, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course! I mean, there's no way spinning your own cotton candy isn't gonna be fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. Oh, cotton candy.
That suits you both so well!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Does that mean you think we're being childish?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, not at all! I was just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm suddenly feeling parched.
MEIKO, I'd like some orange juice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
He's gonna make a run for it!
Rin, you go around that way!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
You're not getting away from us, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, great teamwork, you two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, even after all this talk about the School Festival nearly causing them to fight.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha. Isn't that wonderful, KAITO?
You helped them make up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
P-Please, everyone!
Stop laughing and lend me a hand!
